reply.text: This is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I won't weigh in on the knee itself. Please get it looked at before you decide anything about running this week. Once they've cleared you, tell me what they say and I'll plan the training around it, including whether running fits this week. In the meantime, I can keep the lifting side moving with you, and we can talk through what to avoid as soon as you know.
